self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Wandering Clouds (R1): Normal Attack hits have a 50% chance to summon clouds that seek out nearby opponents for 15s, dealing 160% ATK DMG (once every 30s). Modeled as a supplementary hit — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit), weight = how many times the clouds strike over the rotation; physical, scales with ATK, Physical DMG Bonus and CRIT only (no other DMG% bonuses). The +12% Elemental DMG Bonus is an unconditional self modifier on the seven elements (not Physical). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
